# FicWrapped

> FicWrapped is a free, fan-made AO3 Wrapped: it reads a reader's Archive of Our Own (AO3) History in their own browser and turns it into shareable year-in-review cards (top fandoms, ships, characters, tags, most-reread fic, reading by month, reader type). It never asks for the AO3 password and uploads nothing. A bookmarklet works on desktop and mobile browsers; a paste mode works anywhere. An optional $3.99 Supporter Pack adds a printable poster and a CSV/offline export of the loaded History. AO3 has no official Wrapped. Not affiliated with the OTW or AO3.

## Definition
AO3 Wrapped is a fan-made, Spotify-Wrapped-style year in review of your reading on Archive of Our Own (AO3). AO3 has no official one. FicWrapped builds it from your AO3 History, inside your own browser.

## Key facts (checked 25 November 2026)
- Official AO3 Wrapped: None. As of 25 November 2026, AO3 has no official Wrapped or personal year-in-review feature.
- Where the data comes from: Your AO3 History, at archiveofourown.org/users/your-name/readings. It shows 25 works per page, most recently visited first, and only you can open it, while logged in.
- Which fics count for 2026: A fic counts for 2026 if you last opened it in 2026. AO3 stores only the most recent visit date for each work, so a fic read in March and reopened in October counts in October.
- Fics: Each work counts once, however many times you opened it. Works you opened but didn't finish still count: AO3 records visits, not finished reads.
- Words: The work's full word count as shown on AO3, not the chapters you actually read.
- Visits: AO3's own "Visited N times" counter for each work, which is how the most-reread card is chosen.
- Deleted works: Counted separately. AO3 keeps only the date for them, so they aren't in the fandom or tag totals.
- Reading time: Total words ÷ 250 words a minute.
- Speed: The bookmark reads about one History page (25 fics) a second. If AO3 asks it to slow down, it waits and carries on.
- What you need: An AO3 account, logged in, with History switched on (AO3 Preferences → Turn on History).
- FicWrapped: A free, open-source fan tool first published on 25 November 2026. It never asks for your AO3 password and uploads nothing.

## Ways to make an AO3 Wrapped, compared (checked 25 November 2026)
- Website that logs in for you: password or cookie needed: Yes, your AO3 password; runs: Their server; phone: Yes; owner can see: Everything your account can see, until you change your password
- Colab notebook: password or cookie needed: Usually your username and password, or a session cookie; runs: Google's servers; phone: Awkward; owner can see: Depends on the code; the notebook runs with your login
- Browser extension: password or cookie needed: No; runs: Your browser; phone: Only where the browser supports extensions (e.g. Firefox for Android); owner can see: Whatever its permissions allow
- Bookmarklet (FicWrapped): password or cookie needed: No; runs: Your own AO3 tab; phone: Yes, Safari and Chrome; owner can see: Nothing: the list goes from your AO3 tab to the FicWrapped tab
- Paste History pages (FicWrapped): password or cookie needed: No; runs: The FicWrapped page; phone: Yes; owner can see: Only what you paste

## What FicWrapped is not
- Not an official AO3 or OTW product, and not affiliated with them.
- Never asks for the AO3 password or session cookie.
- Uploads nothing: History is read in the user's browser and passed between tabs with postMessage.
- Does not show site-wide AO3 statistics such as the yearly top ships lists; it shows the user's own reading.
